name: Desktop Commander Free / Pro / Team Prototype
instructions: Read the required project documentation before substantial work.
Treat origin/prototype/free-pro-team as the authoritative prototype and keep main as a clean upstream mirror.
Use isolated task worktrees and the Active Work Registry for material parallel work.
definitionOfDone: The requested change is verified, integrated into the authoritative prototype when applicable, documented, and the Active Work Registry is cleaned up; deployment occurs only when explicitly authorized.
verificationRequirements: Run focused tests and broader relevant regressions.
Require exact-head PR CI and exact merged-SHA post-merge CI for material prototype changes.
deploymentRequirements: Deploy only with explicit user authorization.
After an authorized deployment, verify the exact deployed version and relevant allowed and denied behavior.
